text:
No option can be put forward from this run: the £400k annual-salary limit was not assessable, and the model is very fragile.

- The model could not compare its calculated salary-spend change with the **£400k/year** limit, so budget compliance was withheld rather than guessed.
- It also assumed that more “new platform delivery by Q3” is better; that objective direction was not explicitly stated.
- Delivery capacity is the most sensitive assumption; it is an Olumi estimate, not user evidence. The options produced nearly identical outcome distributions, so the uncertainty itself is the finding.
